about.description: SPYX is an ETF perpetual listed on Phemex, tracking State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 4h. Up to 10x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
